pre_task_context:
Session with the operator's AI assistant (ZCode, GLM-5.3) before implementation started.

Operator kick-off message (verbatim, Russian): "[README.md](./README.md) запускай если нужно агентов, не забудь поднять сначала review агента, ты сам pr не отправляешь, зовешь меня, когда все сделал и все review агенты одобрили и я сам помотрю" — i.e. follow the README, use agents where needed, keep a review agent in the loop, do NOT open the PR yourself; finish the work, get review approvals, then hand off to the operator for a final human look.

Task source digested from the operator's README (bounty #834, $40, UnsafeLabs/Bounty-Hunters): the T3 Code web app component ProviderModelPicker does not remember the selected AI provider/model across page reloads. Required behavior: (1) persist selected provider id and model id to localStorage on selection; (2) restore the saved values on component mount; (3) if the saved provider is no longer available, fall back gracefully to the first available one; (4) add a "Reset to default" option that clears the saved settings. Acceptance criteria: selection survives a page reload; invalid saved values fall back to the first available option; Reset clears the localStorage keys and returns the default; several tabs stay in sync via the storage event; localStorage keys are namespaced (e.g. t3code.provider / t3code.model); with empty localStorage the picker's behavior must not change. PR rules: include _generation.json with this pre_task_context field next to the code changes; title format "[Agent Name] [ T3 Code ] Fix ProviderModelPicker persistence...". The operator flagged this bounty board as unverified (possible free-work farm), so this is a small test submission only, and issues #611/#270 attached as merge prerequisites are explicitly out of scope.

Repo was forked to the operator's account (c0dem4sters) and cloned; branch fix/provider-model-picker-persistence created from upstream main before any code exploration began.
